description: This source file defines the MonkeyFlipEvent class, which represents a flip event in the Android 'monkey' testing tool. It contains byte sequences for flipping the keyboard state and injects these events into the system via file I/O.

classes.name: MonkeyFlipEvent
classes.description: Represents a flip event in the Android monkey testing utility, capable of simulating screen flip or keyboard flip events by writing specific byte sequences to an input device.

methods.name: MonkeyFlipEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the flip event with whether the keyboard is open or closed.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the flip event into the system by writing to /dev/input/event0, indicating whether the keyboard is open or closed.
